## hashFileBasenameAndDir() function

A short, stable hash using the basename and directory of a file path.

Only the last two path segments are used, so that names are stable regardless of the absolute location of a project. This intentionally avoids `node:crypto` and `node:path` so that this module can run in a browser bundle.
